headword: {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}

definitions.explanation: The sale or release of a product before its general availability date, often limited to certain channels or customers.

examples.japanese: {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}で{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I got it through the advance sale.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}ゲームが{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}される。
examples.english: The new game will be released early.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}の{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}で、{一般|いっぱん}{発売|はつばい}より{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{早|はや}く{購入|こうにゅう}できる。
examples.english: Through the members-only advance sale, you can purchase it a week before the general release.

notes:
A compound of {先行|せんこう} (preceding/going ahead) and {発売|はつばい} (sale/release). Common in marketing for music, games, books, and consumer electronics. The concept appeals to fans and early adopters who want products before the general public.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}される: to be released early
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}{開始|かいし}: advance sale begins
- {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}{先行発売|せんこうはつばい}: members-only advance sale
- {先行発売|せんこうはつばい}チケット: advance sale tickets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先行販売|せんこうはんばい}: advance selling (almost synonymous; {販売|はんばい} emphasizes the selling process)
- {予約販売|よやくはんばい}: pre-order sales
- {発売|はつばい}: release; putting on sale
- {先行予約|せんこうよやく}: advance reservation/pre-order
